projects.name: Asir Leaf: telling coffee-plant diseases apart from phone photos
projects.description: Collected and labelled 6,400 leaf photos with farmers' cooperatives and an agronomist, cleaned the dataset by removing blurred images, and balanced classes using augmentation (rotating, flipping, cropping). Used transfer learning in PyTorch by retraining the last layers of a pretrained network. Evaluated the model with precision and recall per disease and a confusion matrix, using a held-out farm's photos never seen during training. Tuned hyperparameters across 24 combinations of learning rate, batch size, and frozen layers based on validation performance. Compressed the final model for fast (<1 second) offline inference on a mid-range Android phone and deployed it in an app used by eleven farmers for a month. Achieved 93% correct classification across five disease classes; received an A+ and a 2nd prize at the university's 2026 undergraduate research day.
